notes.title: Friday will be free-to-play soon
notes.content:
Almost two years after its release, Friday has managed to recoup its development costs thanks to the support of many players. Meow Bunny Studio is very grateful for the support of all the players who have purchased the game. It is your passion that keeps us motivated.

We have decided to change the price of Friday from the previous $0.99 to free to play on September 20th at 12 am EST, in order to make the game more accessible to a wider audience.

We hope that those who are interested in our will purchase the game after the price change to avoid any inconvenience.



Meow Bunny Studio

notes.title: Price Changing
notes.content: According to the feedback of our player, our studio has decided to change the price of our game. The price proposal has been submitted to Steam. We will make an official announcement when the price is finalized. Anyone who has an interest in our game can wait for the release of the new (lower) price. We wish you luck with your work at Cat Technology.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Fix a bug related to interaction with locker, fixed a bug about item "Love Letter".

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Fix one bug related to achievement system.

notes.title: Recent Updates and Upcoming Discount
notes.content: Thank you for playing Friday and supporting our studio. We've recently made several updates to the game, solving issues that affect the game's progress and optimizing the puzzle-solving experience. We've also updated the game walkthrough in the Steam Guides section. At the same time, we will offer a discount promotion the following week, and players who wish to purchase our work will receive a 50% OFF discount.

notes.title: Friday is realse in November
notes.content:
Many players may realize that our game was not released as planned on November 15th. Don't worry, we have finished the game. We are improving the quality of the text and keep fixing bugs. The game "Friday" will be available for sale in November. Our current pricing for the game is $2.99. If you have any suggestions for this pricing, you can leave a message to let us know. 


Good Luck

MeowBunny Studio
